requirements.text: Personalised timetable management allowing full colour customisation for modules.
Ability to hide cancelled classes in the timetable.
Automated grade notification system where students can choose their notification preferences (email, SMS, or in-app).
Notifications should be delivered within five minutes of a grade being posted.
Structured module feedback system including specific questions covering key aspects such as content quality, teaching methods, and resources, with a rating scale for quantitative feedback.
Option for open-text responses to allow students to provide detailed feedback.
Focus on a few targeted questions to keep the feedback process manageable for students.
Ensure anonymity in the feedback process, with no identifiable information linked to feedback.
Aggregated results of feedback should be made available to module coordinators only after grades are submitted.
